name: Being Spiritually Awake
overview: Scripture calls believers to maintain spiritual vigilance by watching and praying continually, recognizing that the timing of Christ's return is unknown and can come unexpectedly. Being spiritually awake involves guarding against the distractions of worldly excess and cares, staying active in prayer and thanksgiving, and living as doers of God's Word rather than mere hearers. This alertness is not passive but a call to arise from spiritual slumber so that Christ may illuminate the believer's life and enable them to stand worthy before the Son of Man.
